mapper.select:
select d.id, d.device_no, d.name, d.category, d.brand, d.model, d.premise_id, d.location, d.install_date, d.warranty_end, d.maintain_cycle_days, d.last_maintain_date, d.next_maintain_date, d.status, case when d.next_maintain_date is not null and d.next_maintain_date <= curdate() then 1 else 0 end as maintain_due, case when d.warranty_end is not null and d.warranty_end < curdate() then 1 else 0 end as warranty_expired from dev_device d
and d.device_no like concat('%', #{deviceNo}, '%') and d.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and d.category = #{category} and d.status = #{status}
and d.next_maintain_date is not null and d.next_maintain_date <= curdate()
order by d.category, d.device_no
